finite_theorem.statement: Every nonempty binary Z12 profile either lives in a translation orbit whose quotient names only the orbit, or has stabilizer symmetry that leaves multiple compatible slots.  Nonzero circular/Fourier resultants rotate covariantly with translations, and lexicographic/canonical representatives import an external order.  Therefore the exhaustive binary profile class supplies receivers and quotient classes, but no import-free strict origin datum coupled to Phi_Info/A_phi.
